$comment: Announcements that ship without a build. Edit, commit to main, and every install shows them on the next launch. id must be stable (that is what de-duplicates a post across launches and keeps a dismissed-looking post from reappearing under a new id). expiresAt is ISO-8601 and optional; an empty string means no expiry. url is optional and opens in the launcher's own browser. banner is optional and names one of the bundled pictures: emergency, urgent, christmas or caramel_plus; a post with no banner draws the art its severity implies (emergency or urgent).
